title: Abraham (Abram)
summary: Son of Terah; called by God from Ur and Haran; father of the faithful (Gen 11–25).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones baseline): 1996 BC (Birth of Abraham) (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 1: Problem, Data, and Methodology," ARJ 15 (2022): 377–390, section "Our Assumptions (Declared Biases)", Table 1 "Biblically derived dates from Ussher and Jones"
birth.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point.

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), p. 77 ("born BC 1996"); "Chronological Compendium", p. 1 (2008 AM)
Ussher, Annals of the World, Second Age §63 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

birth.date: Birth of Abram: Anno Mundi 2008; 1922 B.C. (SBC)
birth.citation: Jordan, "Egypt in Biblical History," Biblical Chronology 5:8 (December 1993), chart "Anno Mundi / B.C. (SBC) / B.C. (CCC)" at the start of the article
birth.note: AM 2008 also in BC 2:6, 4:8 §2, 6:4 §8. B.C. year is Jordan's "SBC" (strictest Biblical chronology), which takes Daniel's 70 weeks literally from Cyrus (456 B.C. instead of the conventional 536 B.C.); not comparable one-to-one with Ussher/CFAH B.C. years.

death.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002, Chronological Compendium p. 1). Leave empty until verified.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §101 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)

death.date: "Abraham died at the age of 175 (Gen. 25:7), in 2183"
death.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 3)," Biblical Chronology 6:5 (May 1994), §10 "The Chronological Structure of Abraham's Life"
